Bill.BriefDescription: Concerning the division of existing surface or ground water rights.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to water rights; and adding a new section tochapter 90.03 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 90.03 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: This section applies to an existing surface or ground water right.At the request of the holder or holders of the right, the departmentshall divide the water right into two or more water rights. If thewater right is held by more than one person, such a division of theright may include dividing the right among the various holders of theright. Such a division of the right does not constitute a change,transfer, or amendment of the water right and a calculation of anannual consumptive quantity of water under RCW 90.03.380(1) does notapply to such a division. If the holder or holders of the water rightagree to the division proposed by the department, the water right isdivided and the department shall issue and record supersedingcertificates or other appropriate documents to the holder or holders ofthe divided right to reflect its division. p. 1 HB 3106 The division of a water right under the authority of this sectiondoes not constitute an adjudication of the right to use water asbetween the water right holder or holders and the state or as betweenthe water right holder or holders and persons with other water rights.
